Games like Path of Exile have done F2P very admirably. It has a production value similar to something like Diablo and none of it's mechanical content is blocked by a pay wall. Want a minor cosmetic upgrade? That's when you gotta pay.

But that's kind of the exception. Games like League of Legends, Dirty Bomb and many others have a lot of grind or else you have to pay. And usually paying for all of the major content goes in excess of 100 dollars. I personally would rather just buy the game at 60 dollars and then pay for major expansions.

To defend League and DOTA: those games are F2P, but all actual game content is available. You don't have to pay for any champions if you don't want to; you don't pay for items or maps. Anything you do buy is purely cosmetic. I have a few skins I've bought in League because I enjoy playing it so much and wanted to stand out on certain champs. That, to me, is the best of F2P. LoL does have a grind to 30, but that's to make sure people actually know how to play the game before they get into the competitive Ranked queues (and serves as a deterrent to smurfing on new accounts).

Now, if League gave you "Energy" and every time you played you had to spend Energy and if you were out of Energy you couldn't play unless you waited or bought more... that would be the bait and switch. That's what's wrong with the bad F2P games.

What I'm saying is that League makes it so that if you want to buy all the champs without money, it requires a very large time investment. Mostly to encourage you to buy more. If they made the IP given per match more fair, say 10-20 matches per champ, you would be less inclined to buy them. If they just sold the game as is at 60 dollars and made it much easier to buy champs after the ones that are included with the game, it wouldn't feel like as much of a grind.

This is why I respect Smite, does the same as LoL but gives you the option to outright buy every character that will ever exist in a single purchase for a pretty reasonable price (Around £30, I think).
I think this is the way it should be done if you still want your game to be F2P. And they still made money off me through skins and voice packs.
